tejano-rider-ride-e-1.request: Request 2026-09-27 — the milk cow on the run, and Béxar before the bell
tejano-rider-ride-e-1.prompt: A Tejano horseman of Béxar, 1836 (as of Seguín's company): a short brown jacket, a white shirt, a red sash, dark split trousers over leather leggings, a low-crowned wide hat; an escopeta held upright, its butt on his thigh; his horse a dun with a dark mane - dress an interpretation, no uniform claimed riding the family's horse side-on facing east (west is the game's mirror), walking, frame 1 of 4 of a four-beat walk (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore; three hooves down at a time, the head nodding). The horse: a muscled bay with a black mane and tail and dark lower legs, a small white star, a plain saddle on a red blanket, jointed legs with round fetlocks and sloping pasterns. The rider sits it astride: the thigh down and forward, the knee bent, the foot in the stirrup under the hip, the hands low at the reins, riding the horse's rise and fall. Warm hand-drawn storybook style, thin dark olive-brown outline, flat shade to the lower right, slightly elevated north-up three-quarter view; transparent ground, no shadow, no text. Claude-drawn stand-in, temporary: replace with Astra's tejano-rider-ride-e-1.
tejano-rider-ride-e-1.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)
